text_block_list.text:
"...Biko Pegasus was so choked with frustration,
she couldn't even speak..."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"I tried so hard for today!
I was sure that this time... for sure...!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Still... is it no good after all...?
Can I really not be a hero...?
choice_data_list: Let's do our best together again!
If you give up here, you'll never make it, you know?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Yeah, you're right!
As long as I'm with my friends, I can get back up any number of times!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"...To be honest, I'm still frustrated...
Completely and utterly frustrated!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Even though I always lose... I still
don't want to give up on becoming a hero—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
So!
Can I give it my best again!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh... Yeah! Yeah!
Let's do tons of special training once we get back!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh!
Why are you being so mean?!
choice_data_list: Because I believe I can become a hero.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I see... Trainer wasn't trying to be mean; they were giving me a push on the back, telling me I can still keep going...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
…………I want to believe too!
That if you don't give up, you can become a hero!
choice_data_list: No matter how many times we fall, let's get back up!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Exactly!
If I can't win, I'll just keep getting back up until I do!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That's me, Justice Biko!
The Uma Musume who'll become everyone's hero someday!
